properties.name: security.jwt.secret
properties.description: Shared HMAC secret used by api-gateway to validate JWT tokens emitted by auth-service.

properties.name: security.jwt.issuer
properties.description: Expected issuer claim for JWT tokens emitted by auth-service.

properties.name: gateway.routes.auth-service-url
properties.description: Base URL used by api-gateway to route requests to auth-service.

properties.name: gateway.routes.inventory-service-url
properties.description: Base URL used by api-gateway to route requests to inventario.

properties.name: gateway.routes.inventory-api-key
properties.description: Internal API key forwarded by api-gateway to inventario as X-API-Key.

properties.name: gateway.routes.orders-service-url
properties.description: Base URL used by api-gateway to route requests to pedidos.

properties.name: gateway.routes.orders-api-key
properties.description: Internal API key forwarded by api-gateway to pedidos as X-API-Key.

properties.name: gateway.routes.shipping-service-url
properties.description: Base URL used by api-gateway to route requests to envios.

properties.name: gateway.routes.shipping-api-key
properties.description: Internal API key forwarded by api-gateway to envios as X-API-Key.

properties.name: gateway.routes.rabbit-admin-service-url
properties.description: Base URL used by api-gateway to route requests to rabbitmq-admin (EP3).

properties.name: gateway.routes.rabbit-admin-api-key
properties.description: Internal API key forwarded by api-gateway to rabbitmq-admin as X-API-Key.

properties.name: gateway.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of frontend origins allowed by api-gateway CORS configuration.
